description: Sampling coverage and S0-vs-S1 seed-paired outcomes (an association, not an isolated cause). (A) unique exact-K support pool size per seed changes from a median of 4,032.5 (S1 at 15,000 shots) to 1,207.5 (Control B: S1 resampled independently at 5,000 shots, matching everyone else's budget). (B) S0 win fraction against S1 across downstream budget B: the crossover (S0 losing a majority of seeds) is seen in the 15k-shot configuration; Control B, the independent 5k-shot draw, gives a 5-0-5 split at B=60 and B=100 (no detected difference, not equivalence).
